json_proto.name: BORROWER_360_MODEL

queries.sqlText: SELECT borrower_asset_class, COUNT(*) FROM BORROWER360.CURATED.BORROWER_360 GROUP BY borrower_asset_class
queries.correspondingQuestion: How many borrowers are in each RBI asset classification?

queries.sqlText: SELECT borrower_id, full_name, ltv_expected_interest_inr FROM BORROWER360.CURATED.BORROWER_360 WHERE bt_is_a_flight_risk = TRUE ORDER BY ltv_expected_interest_inr DESC LIMIT 20
queries.correspondingQuestion: Which borrowers are a genuine balance transfer flight risk, ranked by lifetime value?

queries.sqlText: SELECT borrower_id, full_name, overall_sentiment_direction, any_ptp_made_then_missed FROM BORROWER360.CURATED.BORROWER_360 WHERE overall_sentiment_direction = 'DETERIORATING'
queries.correspondingQuestion: Which borrowers have a deteriorating sentiment trajectory across their calls?

queries.sqlText: SELECT r.borrower_id, r.action_code, r.rule_basis, r.expected_value_inr FROM BORROWER360.AI.NBA_RECOMMENDATION r WHERE r.status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND r.action_family = 'COLLECTIONS'
queries.correspondingQuestion: What pending collections actions are recommended and why?

queries.sqlText: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BORROWER360.CURATED.BORROWER_360 WHERE is_npa = TRUE AND npa_upgrade_eligible = TRUE
queries.correspondingQuestion: How many NPA borrowers are eligible to upgrade back to standard?

json_proto.semanticDescription: Unified borrower 360 for an Indian mixed-NBFC retail lending portfolio. Combines RBI-compliant credit risk classification (borrower-level, per IRAC norms), balance-transfer flight risk (structurally separated from credit risk - a distressed borrower always scores zero BT risk), a lifetime-value proxy (expected future interest income from the real amortization schedule, assuming the loan runs to full term), and sentiment/behavioral trajectory signals derived from sequenced call transcripts. Paired with the deterministic next-best-action recommendation engine, where every action traces to a named rule and carries an expected value.
